text: Monthly heartworm preventive: if a dose is missed, give it as soon as you remember, as long as it is within about 3 days of the due date. Never give two doses to catch up. If it is later than that, contact the vet before dosing, since the pet may need a heartworm test.
Flea and tick preventive: if a dose is missed, apply or give it when remembered, within about a week of the due date. Do not double up. If later than a week, ask the vet.

Antibiotics given once or twice a day: if a dose is missed, give it when remembered only if it is within about 4 hours of the due time. Otherwise skip it and resume the normal schedule. Never double a dose. Finish the whole course.

Pain and anti-inflammatory medication (NSAIDs): if a dose is missed, give it when remembered only if it is within about 6 hours of the due time. Otherwise skip it and wait for the next scheduled dose. Never double a dose. NSAIDs can upset the stomach, so call the vet if the pet is vomiting.
